utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Let the Registrar call the case, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. This is Case Number IT-99-37-I, the Prosecutor versus Milan Milutinovic, Nikola Sainovic, and Dragoljub Ojdanic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: May I have the appearances for the Prosecutor.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICE
utterances.text: The Prosecutor appears today by me, with Kristina Romano and Milbert Chen, and our case manager is Susan Grogan.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Nice. For the Defence.

utterances.speaker: MR. LIVINGSTON
utterances.text: John Livingston for the defendant Milan Milutinovic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Livingston. This is the initial appearance of Mr. Milan Milutinovic upon his transfer to the Tribunal, and the hearing is to be conducted in accordance with Rule 62. The accused will be asked to enter a plea on the indictment dated the 19th of July, 2002. Mr. Livingston, may I take it that the accused has received copies of the third amended indictment?

utterances.speaker: MR. LIVINGSTON
utterances.text: Yes, he's seen that. I've discussed it with him, and if it helps, it would be perfectly in order for it to be put in a short form to him.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: I take that to mean that he has waived the right to have it read to him.

utterances.speaker: MR. LIVINGSTON
utterances.text: Yes, with the rest of it.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: You have explained the indictment to him?

utterances.speaker: MR. LIVINGSTON
utterances.text: Yes, I have.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: You have explained the charges to him?

utterances.speaker: MR. LIVINGSTON
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Livingston. Mr. Milutinovic, please stand. You've heard what your counsel has said: The indictment has been explained to you, he has been through it with you. You may, if you wish, have time to consider your plea. And you will, in that regard, have a period of up to 30 days. On the other hand, if you wish to enter a plea to the counts today, you may do so. Do you wish to enter your plea today?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes, I do.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Very well. I'll put the counts to you, and to each count you will enter a plea. Confine your answers to "guilty" or "not guilty." Count 1 of the indictment charges you with deportation, a crime against humanity, punishable under Article 5(d) of the Statute of the Tribunal. How do you plead; guilty or not guilty?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Not guilty.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Count 2 of the indictment charges you with other inhumane acts, forcible transfer, a crime against humanity, punishable under Article 5(i) of the Statute of the Tribunal. How do you plead? Blank page inserted to ensure pagination corresponds between the French and English transcripts.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Not guilty.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: And count 3 of the indictment charges you with murder, a crime against humanity, punishable under Article 5(a) of the Statute. How do you plead?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Not guilty.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Count 4 charges you with murder, a violation of the laws or customs of war, punishable under Article 3 of the Statute of the Tribunal, and recognised by Article 3(1)(a) of the Geneva Conventions. How do you plead?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Not guilty.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Count 5 of the indictment charges you with persecutions on political, racial, and religious grounds, a crime against humanity, punishable by Article 5(h) of the Statute of the Tribunal. How do you plead?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Not guilty.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: That completes the plea. You may sit. Mr. Nice, I just take the opportunity to remind you of the Prosecutor's obligation under Rule 66(A)(ii) to make available to the accused, within 30 days of the initial appearance, copies of the supporting material accompanying the indictment as well as all prior statements obtained by the Prosecutor from the accused.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICE
utterances.text: I think it may be 66(A)(i), and I am happy to tell Your Honour that all that material, some 16 binders of it, is available for service forthwith save for one outstanding item. I have explained what the item is to Mr. Livingston. It is referred to in a letter by which the 16 binders will be receipted, and we forecast that that one outstanding item should be served within about a week, maybe less, maybe indeed, by the end of this week. We hope so. By service of that last item of confirmation materials under 66(A)(i), of course there is triggered the running of time for preliminary motions by the accused.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Very well. I am glad to hear that that matter is in hand. Is there any particular matter that you wish to raise, Mr. Livingston?

utterances.speaker: MR. LIVINGSTON
utterances.text: There is one matter I'd like to raise, but I think that will have to be in private session rather than in open session.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Very well. We’ll go into private session.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: We're in open session, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Yes, I have to say that the Status Conference will take place on Thursday, February the 13th, at 3.00 p.m., which is also the date of the Status Conference in respect of the other accused in this case. Are there any other matters? None.

utterances.speaker: MR. NICE
utterances.text: I thank Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: There being no other matters, the hearing is adjourned.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: at 3.08 p.m.
